title: Quarterly sprint-lane template and signal mapping for Hosted API + Model Catalog
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Create a repeatable, cohort-aligned quarterly sprint-lane template and associated signal mapping for coordinating Hosted API route changes and model catalog rotations. Goal is to reduce decision friction between PM/Eng/Design during quarterly planning and to make OKR-linked tradeoffs explicit (latency vs cost vs model quality). Deliverables: a templated calendar, gating checklist, signal taxonomy (quality/latency/cost/adoption), rollback policy matrix, and a short training doc for PMs and Eng leads.
acceptance_criteria: A1: A reusable sprint-lane template (calendar + milestones) is published in Confluence and linked from the PM handbook
A2: Signal taxonomy documented with thresholds for canary, scale-up, and rollback actions
A3: At least two cross-functional dry-runs completed with Eng and Design leads and feedback incorporated
A4: Dashboard panels (latency/cost/errors/quality-regression) created and linked in the playbook
A5: Template includes explicit OKR mapping examples and a decision log format for tradeoffs
comments: 2026-03-10 Ava Martinez: Ticket created after roadmap sync. Problem: mounting friction between model rotations and endpoint SLA commitments. Proposal: sprint-lane template + signal mapping to make handoffs explicit.
2026-03-11 Jordan Patel: Added initial list of signals we should track. Asking Eng to estimate dashboard build time. Noted overlap with capacity hedging project; added ENG-3821 as dependency.

2026-03-12 Priya Singh (Engineering lead): Prefer lightweight signal thresholds for first iteration (P99 latency, regression rate, token cost delta). Tradeoff: fine-grained thresholds will add alert churn; we recommend dynamic thresholds by cohort.
2026-03-13 Maya Chen (Design): Will produce a one-page visual of the sprint-lane calendar for the PM handbook. Suggest using color-coded lanes for canary windows and rollback blocks.

2026-03-14 Jordan Patel: Draft playbook uploaded to Confluence draft space. Requesting reviews from Reliability and SRE. Linking tentative Grafana panels: /grafana/d/hostedapi-roadmap/quarterly-signal-lane?view=summary
2026-03-14 Engineering note: ENG-4099 will provide an API for automated canary tagging; without it some actions will be manual. Decision: ship MVP with manual tagging, add automation in next cycle.
notes: Design tradeoffs: visual simplicity vs completeness. Start simple and iterate based on cross-functional dry-run notes.
Operational constraint: Dedicated capacity customers may require separate lanes; include an example appendix for Dedicated/Private deployments.
Risk: If we set thresholds too tight we will trigger unnecessary rollbacks. Mitigation: run historical backtest against last 6 months of signals before freeze.
